**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14 UTC) shipped config generation 119, flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That made every request claim its own pooled connection instead of sharing one, so the fixed 20-connection pool saturated within seconds of the config applying.

**Impact window:** Started 2026-03-14 02:14:14 UTC, roughly 30s after the deploy finished. Still ongoing as of the last log line, 03:59:27 UTC — no recovery yet, and the wait queue has grown from 13 to 74 over that time. Every error is `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)`, with `WARN pool ... acquire slow` warnings a few seconds ahead of each burst.

**Scope:** Gateway only. `worker.log` shows workers ran a separate pool and stayed healthy throughout — no correlated errors there.

**Rollback:** Revert `dep-4471` — set `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false` (or raise the pool size if per-request isolation needs to stay). No other deploy in that window touches the gateway.
